title: Pullman's estate signed off; a planted bed in the stable court
items: A small bed now grows inside the stable court's gateway on 18th Street, by the stable's corner bay, as an 1890s photograph shows it: a dark clipped evergreen, a low flowering shrub and a little clipped cone.
The palm house and the stable now match all six of their pictures, so the estate's photo match is complete.
The ivy on the house's 18th Street side is re-laid around its rebuilt east windows.
